title: SwiftRide – Urban Ride-Hailing Mobile App
author: Asinu Kumarage
overview: SwiftRide is a cross-platform mobile ride-hailing application designed to solve urban commuting friction. It features real-time vehicle dispatching, map integration, and an in-app payment interface.
keyFeatures: **Real-time driver matching** powered by WebSockets to ensure low-latency dispatch and routing
**Mapbox SDK integration** with path plotting, traffic warnings, and live ETA tracking
**Cross-platform mobile client** built with React Native for native-speed UI performance
**Secure payment flows** supporting credit cards, mobile wallets, and ride credit systems
